headline: Doing Business Will Become Easier! 'Udyog Mitra Portal' Launched in Delhi, Businesspeople Will Get These Facilities
summary: Delhi has launched the Udyog Mitra Portal as a single-window digital platform. Businesspeople and entrepreneurs can complete necessary registrations through one platform instead of visiting several departments.
why: Single-window systems reduce administrative friction for companies, which affects how quickly new businesses can register and operate in India's capital region.
